He and [[Sarah Clements]] received [[Cooper Howard]], a famous actor, at [[California Crest Studios]] when he was convinced to film an advertisement for Vault-Tec on the urging of his wife [[Barb Howard|Barb]], one of the company's executives. Cooper told them that he had never filmed any ads before this one, which George and Sarah laughed off. Later, after Cooper put on a [[Vault jumpsuit]] for the ad, he asked them if it was protective against radiation. Barb gave George and Sarah a side-eye, and they hesitated before Sarah claimed that the jumpsuit did, in fact, do so. They proceeded to watch Cooper pose for the ad.''Fallout'' Season 1 Episode 3: "[[The Head]]" George was later accepted into [[Vault 31]] as part of [[Bud Askins]]' experimental pet project and [[Cryonics|cryonically]] frozen, surviving the [[Great War]]. [[Grand Canyon Brotherhood of Steel|Grand Canyon Brotherhood]] |rank =Elder |location =[[Grand Canyon]] |titles = |family = |TV actor =[[Chris Browning]] }} The '''Grand Canyon elder''' is a leader of the [[Grand Canyon Brotherhood of Steel|Grand Canyon Brotherhood]], a chapter of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]]. ==Background== The elder of a separate Brotherhood of Steel chapter based in the [[Grand Canyon]] region in 2296. This is one of the Brotherhood's regional branches, subordinate to the larger organizational structure but enjoying considerable autonomy. The elder is an elderly man (approximately 60+ years old), with a stern, experienced, and slightly cynical appearance. He has a well-groomed, gray-white beard of medium length and gray receding hair combed back. He has blue eyes and wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes. The elder also has a scar with an inset Arizona [[license plate]] with the embossed inscription "GRAND CANYON STATE" acting as a skull plate visible on his forehead. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== The elder was invited by Senior Cleric [[Quintus]] to a secret meeting with strategists from [[Yosemite elder|Yosemite]] and [[Coronado elder|Coronado]].
